title: Vasya and Public Transport
statementMd:
Vasya often uses public transport. The transport in the city is of two types: trolleys and buses. The city has $*n*$ buses and $*m*$ trolleys, the buses are numbered by integers from $1$ to $*n*$, the trolleys are numbered by integers from $1$ to $*m*$.

Public transport is not free. There are 4 types of tickets:

1. A ticket for one ride on some bus or trolley. It costs $*c*_{1}$ burles;
2. A ticket for an unlimited number of rides on some bus or on some trolley. It costs $*c*_{2}$ burles;
3. A ticket for an unlimited number of rides on all buses or all trolleys. It costs $*c*_{3}$ burles;
4. A ticket for an unlimited number of rides on all buses and trolleys. It costs $*c*_{4}$ burles.

Vasya knows for sure the number of rides he is going to make and the transport he is going to use. He asked you for help to find the minimum sum of burles he will have to spend on the tickets.

## Input

The first line contains four integers $*c*_{1}, *c*_{2}, *c*_{3}, *c*_{4}$ $(1 ≤ *c*_{1}, *c*_{2}, *c*_{3}, *c*_{4} ≤ 1000)$ — the costs of the tickets.

The second line contains two integers $*n*$ and $*m*$ $(1 ≤ *n*, *m* ≤ 1000)$ — the number of buses and trolleys Vasya is going to use.

The third line contains $*n*$ integers $*a*_{*i*}$ $(0 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 1000)$ — the number of times Vasya is going to use the bus number $*i*$.

The fourth line contains $*m*$ integers $*b*_{*i*}$ $(0 ≤ *b*_{*i*} ≤ 1000)$ — the number of times Vasya is going to use the trolley number $*i*$.

## Output

Print a single number — the minimum sum of burles Vasya will have to spend on the tickets.

## Note

In the first sample the profitable strategy is to buy two tickets of the first type (for the first bus), one ticket of the second type (for the second bus) and one ticket of the third type (for all trolleys). It totals to $(2·1) + 3 + 7 = 12$ burles.

In the second sample the profitable strategy is to buy one ticket of the fourth type.

In the third sample the profitable strategy is to buy two tickets of the third type: for all buses and for all trolleys.
statementZhMd:
Vasya 经常乘坐公共交通工具。城市中的公共交通有两种：无轨电车和公共汽车。城市中有 $*n*$ 辆公共汽车和 $*m*$ 辆无轨电车，公共汽车的编号为 $1$ 到 $*n*$，无轨电车的编号为 $1$ 到 $*m*$。

公共交通并不是免费的。车票有 4 种类型：

1. 乘坐某一辆公共汽车或无轨电车一次的车票，价格为 $*c*_{1}$ 卢布；
2. 可无限次乘坐某一辆公共汽车或某一辆无轨电车的车票，价格为 $*c*_{2}$ 卢布；
3. 可无限次乘坐所有公共汽车或所有无轨电车的车票，价格为 $*c*_{3}$ 卢布；
4. 可无限次乘坐所有公共汽车和无轨电车的车票，价格为 $*c*_{4}$ 卢布。

Vasya 确切知道自己将要乘坐的交通工具以及乘坐次数。请你帮助他求出购买车票所需支付的最小卢布数。

## 输入格式

第一行包含四个整数 $*c*_{1}, *c*_{2}, *c*_{3}, *c*_{4}$ $(1 ≤ *c*_{1}, *c*_{2}, *c*_{3}, *c*_{4} ≤ 1000)$，分别表示各种车票的价格。

第二行包含两个整数 $*n*$ 和 $*m*$ $(1 ≤ *n*, *m* ≤ 1000)$，分别表示 Vasya 将要乘坐的公共汽车和无轨电车的数量。

第三行包含 $*n*$ 个整数 $*a*_{*i*}$ $(0 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 1000)$，其中 $*a*_{*i*}$ 表示 Vasya 将乘坐编号为 $*i*$ 的公共汽车的次数。

第四行包含 $*m*$ 个整数 $*b*_{*i*}$ $(0 ≤ *b*_{*i*} ≤ 1000)$，其中 $*b*_{*i*}$ 表示 Vasya 将乘坐编号为 $*i*$ 的无轨电车的次数。

## 输出格式

输出一个数，即 Vasya 购买车票所需支付的最小卢布数。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，最优方案是为第一辆公共汽车购买两张第一类车票，为第二辆公共汽车购买一张第二类车票，并为所有无轨电车购买一张第三类车票。总花费为 $(2·1) + 3 + 7 = 12$ 卢布。

在第二个样例中，最优方案是购买一张第四类车票。

在第三个样例中，最优方案是购买两张第三类车票：一张用于所有公共汽车，另一张用于所有无轨电车。
